aging-room--quattro-nicaragua.description: Rafael Nodal's Quattro Nicaragua, introduced in 2019, was the first Quattro not made by Jochy Blanco in the Dominican Republic: a Nicaraguan puro rolled at A.J. Fernandez in Estelí. It is earthy and rich, with dark coffee, chocolate and nuts over a pepper that builds steadily toward the end.

thirds.notes: Earth and dark coffee with chocolate, nuts and wood, and a pepper that comes and goes.
Chocolate and coffee settle in with nuts and earth, a touch of citrus and dried fruit, as the pepper rises again.
Pepper returns strongly with sweet cedar, a little nuttiness and dark chocolate as the smoke turns creamier.
